video_title: 100 Hours in LA as an NBA Player

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the importance of early training and consistency
quotes.excerpt: I'm training my mind, my body now, and yeah, cross the day with me.
quotes.quote: We back in LA, training at the Excel, 6:30 in the morning. Come in, get it in early, and just assimilate the season. Because in the season, you got to wake up early anyway. So, I'm training my mind, my body now, and yeah, cross the day with me.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his commitment to improvement and consistency
quotes.excerpt: I'm trying to be elite, not just good. I don't even need to be elite.
quotes.quote: I try to make deep improvements. I'm trying to be elite, not just good. I don't even need to be elite. So, you got to push a little bit harder. That's the goal. Do it now, every day, push it, push it, push it. I want to get a little bit better each day. I'm not looking for a huge margin, just a little better each day. And over time, after you get the separation.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on focusing on off-the-dribble and creative shooting
quotes.excerpt: Today I'm going to focus on a lot of off-the-dribble, a lot of just miscellaneous shots.
quotes.quote: Today I'm going to focus on a lot of off-the-dribble, a lot of just miscellaneous shots. Just wherever my creative mind can bring in. Because I think that's what really pushes, you know, the greats that I watched, when it gets into a mode where they can't be stopped, like in the third quarter, fourth quarter, playoffs, when you know all the plays. So, yeah, I'm excited for that. Let's get to work. Let's get it.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the importance of recovery for young players
quotes.excerpt: All the young hoopers out there, recovery is key. You can't do this without recovery.
quotes.quote: All the young hoopers out there, recovery is key. You can't do this without recovery. Don't try, it ain't going to work.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his commitment to hard work and consistency
quotes.excerpt: I'm just putting the work in. So I'm just putting the work in each and every day.
quotes.quote: I'm just putting the work in. So I'm just putting the work in each and every day. And then when it's time to show y'all know why, what it is, what it is.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his development and preparation for the season
quotes.excerpt: I keep the true. I want my last game, though. That's good, but I'm trying to get straight.
quotes.quote: I keep the true. I want my last game, though. That's good, but I'm trying to get straight, ramp up. So when the lights come on for real, I'm ready to go. Right now, I'm working on my game. Trying to just stay in shape, competing, trying to just lift the gym up, talking shit, just doing everything, having fun, competing. That's what I do.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the blessings of health and consistency
quotes.excerpt: It's a blessing to be healthy. Each and every day you healthy, it's a blessing.
quotes.quote: It's a blessing to be healthy. Each and every day you healthy, it's a blessing. Because the body is so funny. You don't know how much each body part feels until something wrong. That could be something as simple as a jam finger, something as simple as a roll ankle, something as simple as just having a migraine headache. Whatever the case may be. So, if you healthy, that's the first blessing in life. Thank the Lord for being healthy. Thank the Lord for health.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the importance of deep breathing for recovery
quotes.excerpt: I feel better too with deep breathing today. I did a lot of deep breathing last season.
quotes.quote: I feel better too with deep breathing today. I did a lot of deep breathing last season. I love my heart rate. It's a lot better. Last season I did a lot of deep breathing. It's a two-step process.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his commitment to improving his game
quotes.excerpt: I have no ego. I work on my game. I'm trying to reach new heights.
quotes.quote: I have no fear. I have no ego. I work on my game. I'm trying to reach new heights. I'm competing. I'm attacking the offseason.
